text:
lucas: quick heads-up — ran a focused perf pass on embeddings/rerank endpoint (dim=768, v2 model) after the kernel-selection change. seeing unexpected token-level tail latency on 99th percentiles (~+18%). QPS was stable at ~420. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/emb-rerank/embeddings-rerank-kpis :thinking:

mira: thanks — do you have the profiling traces? is it during cold KV cache or warm?

lucas: attached flamegraph from run at 1769005380, warm cache for most requests but cache-miss spikes every ~3m. flamegraph shows a bit more time in attention kernel fallback path. paste: ```
# perf sample summary
attention_select_kernel()  42%  
kv_cache_lookup()          12%  
softmax_kernel()           8%   
dispatch_sb_dispatch()     25%  
```

raj: hmm could be kernel selector picking generic fp16 path for long sequences => slower kernels. also batch sizing histogram shows more single-request batches than expected. what was the batch size distribution?

lucas: batch histogram (30m window): 1: 22%, 2-4: 40%, 5-8: 25%, 9-16: 10%, >16:3%. we expected >8 to be the dominant bucket after autoscale tuning.

jen: tagging this under observability work. I can add a token-level latency breakdown panel (prompt vs generation vs kv-lookup). suggested promqls: ```
# token-level latency p50/p95/p99 per token stage
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{stage="gen"}[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(requests_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[1m]))
# kv cache hit rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))
```

mira: we should also instrument token_type label (prompt, kv_restore, decode) on token_latency histogram — that will let us see if KV restoration is contributing to tail. Currently we only have "stage".

perf-bot: nightly-profiling job completed for commit abc123 on cluster prod-us-west at 2026-03-01T03:00:00Z. summary attached. regressions flagged: attention-kernel-fallback increased 14% latency.

raj: action items: 1) add token_type to token_latency histogram (obs) 2) add panels: per-route QPS, batch_size distribution histogram, kv_cache_hit_rate, token-level p99s (jen) 3) revert kernel-selector heuristic (canary) to prefer optimized long-seq kernels for embeddings path and run A/B at 5% traffic (mira/raj) 4) throttle small-batch priority to encourage batching (lucas ops tweak)

lucas: agree. small note: embeddings/rerank has tight latency SLO for 95th (<=120ms) and 99th goal 200ms. current p95 ~110ms p99 ~220ms. need to bring p99 down to 200.

jen: will add panels and an alert: alert if route="embeddings/rerank" and histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="embeddings/rerank"}[2m])) by (le)) > 0.20
( i.e. 200ms )

mira: for the KV cache behavior: propose tracking per-request kv_rehydrate_tokens counter and a rolling 1h heatmap to correlate with tail events. sample query: ```
sum by (instance, route) (rate(kv_rehydrate_tokens_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))
```

lucas: also saw that vector dim change (we tested 512 vs 768) changes CPU overhead — ops please note dimension is a knob. dim=512 reduced decode kernel time by ~7% but impacted accuracy slightly.

raj: timeline: put obs changes today, run A/B kernel selector tomorrow (5% traffic), collect 6h traces + batch distribution metrics, then decide on selector rollback or tuning.

lucas: ok i'll open a short PR for the kernel selector flag and share the canary plan in #eng-release. thanks all :thumbsup:

perf-bot: created ticket PERF-4632: "embeddings/rerank p99 regression after kernel-selector change" and attached nightly traces.

mira: adding: please include the per-route tokenization overhead (tokenize_seconds) in the dashboard too — small items add up for short queries.

jen: noted — will push dashboard JSON and link in this thread when ready.
